проходить.gloss: to go through; to come in

meanings.en: to go through; to come in
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (root 'ходить'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to go through', forming an aspectual pair with 'пройти'.
